bubbles.text_with_cues: [curious] WHAT did Billy say he thought these guys were trying to steal again?
[exhales] [thoughtful] Um... some superconducting bio metal... [uncertain] thingy?
[casual] I gotta be honest, man... Sometimes I just smile and nod.
[Reassuringly] I totally do the same thing with Donatello.
[angry] BE QUICK, FOOT CLAN. The MASTERS DEMAND SUCCESS.
[sarcastic] --Or Shredder will just DROP you and brainwash some other MORONS.
[calm, zealous] The same way Zordon recruited you, Pink Ranger. Providing us with the power to make change.
[condescending] Please. [short pause] Allow me to demonstrate.
